title: Experiment Cadence Playbook: OKR-Aligned Milestones, Decision Contracts, and Cross-Team Handoffs
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Purpose: create a repeatable, OKR-aligned experiment cadence that defines milestone checkpoints, explicit decision contracts for canary-to-global rollouts, required instrumentation, cross-team handoffs, and postmortem commitments. Scope: A/B tests, canaries, progressive rollouts, and quick rollback paths for Redwood API, Dedicated routing changes, and Console release flows. This playbook will become the canonical reference for PMs, Eng, Design, SRE, and Solutions when running any experiment that touches production routing or user-visible metrics.
milestones: M1 - Experiment proposal & OKR mapping (owner: PM) — target 2026-03-08
M2 - Instrumentation & eval datasets provisioned (owner: Eng/SRE) — target 2026-03-18
M3 - Canary run (0.5% traffic) + 48h smoke (owner: Eng/Oncall) — target 2026-03-25
M4 - Gradual ramp checkpoints (1%, 5%, 20%) with 24h gates (owners: PM/Eng) — 2026-03-26 to 2026-04-05
M5 - Full rollout sign-off & OKR check (owner: PM/Design/Eng) — target 2026-04-10
M6 - Post-launch evaluation & 14-day regression monitoring (owner: PM/Eng) — complete by 2026-04-24
acceptance_criteria: Clear mapping of experiment to 1-2 OKRs with expected uplift and confidence intervals
Instrumentation validated end-to-end: request-level tags, cohort assignment, event parity with control
Pre-registered primary and guardrail metrics with thresholds and statistical test selection
Rollback and fallback path tested in staging and tabletop runbook reviewed
All stakeholder reviews completed and recorded (SRE, Security if applicable, Design, Legal when customer data impacted)
evaluation_metrics: Primary metric: user-facing success rate delta (relative) — require >=95% CI excluding harm (direction depends on experiment)
Latency guardrail: P95 generation/server-side < +20% relative to baseline AND absolute P95 < 350ms for API tier X
Error rate guardrail: production error rate increase < 0.25 percentage points absolute
Quality guardrail: automated eval on canonical prompt set delta < -1.0% absolute (or manual QA signoff)
Business KPI check: conversion/retention uplift aligned to OKR target (e.g., +2.5% monthly active conversion)
rollout_plan: Step 0: Preflight checklist completed (datasets, dashboards, feature flags, on-call escalation)
Step 1: Launch canary at 0.5% for 48 hours; monitor health and guardrails
Step 2: If canary stable, progress to 1% for 24h then 5% for 24-48h. Each step requires sign-off via decision contract
Step 3: At 20% validate business signal and stability; perform inferred full-sample power check
Step 4: Full rollout (or graduated traffic shaping) with automatic slow-down if guardrails breach
Step 5: Close experiment and publish findings to OKR dashboards and postmortem repository
decision_contracts: Canary pass requires: no guardrail breaches, SRE smoke cleared, minimum sample size met for primary metric — signers: PM + Eng Lead + Oncall
Ramp-to-20% requires additional Design/Product QA for UX regressions and Security attestation if user data changed — signers: PM + Design Lead + Security Owner
Full rollout requires: business KPI trending in expected direction OR explicit ROI justification with risk acceptance — signers: PM + VP Product + Eng Manager
Fallback contract: automatic 5-minute circuit if P95 latency breach > 30% or error rate increase > 1.0pp; on-call rotates into incident handling and rollback decision
instrumentation_requirements: Stable cohort assignment key exposed on every request (experiment_id + bucket)
Feature flag treatment propagation visible in logs and traces
Per-token and per-request cost telemetry for Redwood API endpoints used in experiment
Dashboards: primary metric, guardrails, segmentation by region/model/tier, and raw event sampling link
Evaluation harness: canonical prompt set + deterministic scoring function; scheduled daily mini-evals during rollout
risks: Model-quality regressions that are not captured by automated evals (mitigate with manual QA)
Undetected outlier regions where latency and errors spike (mitigate with region-level gating)
Misalignment with OKR leading to inconclusive business signal (require pre-registration of hypotheses)
Rollback flapping due to noisy metrics if sample sizes are insufficient (require power analysis before ramp)
communication_plan: #experimentation-status Slack channel for live roll updates
Incident runbook link posted to the channel; oncall expectation: 30-min acknowledgement
Weekly sync (15m) for cross-team checkpoints during ramp windows
Final write-up to OKR dashboard + product digest + postmortem published to Confluence/Drive
